summary: Practise NOR checks, laytime calculations, and demurrage claim reviews using charter-party records. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Ship chartering operations training helps chartering coordinators, vessel operators, and demurrage analysts use charter-party terms and port-call records to prepare traceable laytime calculations. You practise checking NOR validity, reconciling SOF event timelines, applying time-counting clauses and exceptions in Excel, and reviewing evidence for demurrage or despatch claims.
audienceIntro: This course suits intermediate shipping professionals who work with charter-party performance, port-call records, cargo operations, or laytime claims. It is designed for people who need to review the contract and operational evidence together before explaining a calculation to a counterparty or reporting exposure to a supervisor.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of shipping operations, voyage chartering, or charter-party documentation is expected. No coding or programming is required. Advanced charter-party interpretation and claim strategy are covered at operational application level; the course does not train you to provide legal advice.
